description: Event-driven orchestrator workflow for coordinating a team of subagents via task board delegation in DM-only mode (no BBS) with agent_spawnable support (create_agent, assign_to). Unlike the blocking variant, the orchestrator ends its turn after creating tasks and gets woken up by subagent DM notifications between turns. Covers the workflow (understand, spawn team, delegate, end turn, review DMs, mediate, report), visualization guidelines, citation protocol, and task creation best practices.
